subject: dsa
title: Reverse Bits
summary: Reversing a fixed-width bit string is a mirror: bit i swaps with bit (width - 1 - i). Walk two pointers in from the ends, swapping each pair until they meet.
problem: Reverse the bits of a fixed-width integer (shown here as 8 bits) so the first bit becomes the last.

steps.caption: Reverse the order of all 8 bits: the first bit becomes the last, and so on. Mirror the row end to end.
Swap the outer pair, bit 0 and bit 7: the 0 and the 1 trade places.
Move inward and swap bit 1 and bit 6; both are 0, so nothing visibly changes.
Swap bit 2 and bit 5: the 1 and the 0 trade places.
Swap the innermost pair, bit 3 and bit 4; both are 1, so no change. The pointers have now met.
Every pair is swapped. The bits are fully reversed: 00111001 became 10011100.
